apps.name: Séance
apps.maturityNote: Estimated: SSH sessions, profiles and encrypted sync are implemented; mobile distribution and platform differences remain rough edges.
apps.summary: Connect to remote machines over SSH, with a file browser and optional encrypted sync.
apps.description: Hauntware's SSH client, with terminal sessions, stored server profiles, ProxyJump chains, a remote file browser and an optional session-aware assistant. Existing standalone downloads remain available until the first suite release.

screenshots.alt: Séance SSH terminal and server browser

apps.name: Poltergeist
apps.maturityNote: Estimated: SFTP transfer, sync and editing are implemented; documented Android and extra-window limitations prevent a polished rating.
apps.summary: Browse and transfer files with a two-pane SFTP client.
apps.description: Hauntware's file-transfer client, with local and remote panes, queued transfers, bookmarks, synchronization and the shared Planchette editor. Install details and platform limitations are documented in the monorepo.

apps.name: Planchette
apps.maturityNote: Estimated: core editing and guarded saves are implemented; distribution, large-file handling and editor scope remain limited.
apps.summary: Edit local text, configuration files and scripts with a focused desktop editor.
apps.description: Hauntware's standalone text editor, with document tabs, find and replace, syntax highlighting, line numbers and guarded saves. Its shared editor foundation is used by Séance and Poltergeist.
